Hard to say from the outside, but something is going on with #Pixelfed 

First DanSup published some sort of a poll earlier today

Wish I could remember what it was -- should DanSup begin to work on some major new project/fork, or something like that...

It was resoundingly nuked by voters: "No!"

DanSup then deleted the poll entirely

Meanwhile on #Github one of the regular devs (I won't out 'em) has been extremely busy deleting entire #Issue threads en masse

Most are of the form:

"Re: [pixelfed/pixelfed] Common Feature Requests (Issue #5813)"

and

"is # 5294 actually "not planned" or it's just being consolidated into this issue?

This is just a very serious cleanup. I will reopen tickets and ask for more information on others."

I didn't realize I might want to keep track, but currently (9:30am PDT) i have some 919 (!) deleted Notification emails from PixelFed in my Thunderbird trash

So there's a major sea-change of some kind underway at Pixelfed on Github that hasn't stopped yet...

OK: a Pixelfed -- Bluesky bridge. Thnx Felipe...
